meta.source: IFPRI/MapSPAM SPAM 2010 v2.0 (V2r0), Harvard Dataverse doi:10.7910/DVN/PRFF8V, CC BY 4.0
meta.variable: physical area (hectares per grid cell), all-technology (_A) aggregate
meta.note: SPAM is a MODELED spatial disaggregation of measured subnational crop statistics onto a 5-arcmin grid; ESTIMATED (model-allocated crop areas), not a field census. Rubber is NOT a standalone SPAM crop (folded into 'rest of crops') so it is absent.

grid.note: cell centre lng = x0+(col+0.5)*res ; lat = y0-(row+0.5)*res

bbox_window.note: Thailand-region window; includes some border-country cells (clipped out by point-in-polygon into Thai amphoe).

meta.extracted_by: pipeline/build_crop_landuse.py --extract (from raw SPAM GeoTIFFs in source-data/.crop_scout/spam/, git-ignored)
